nodes.name: stats.html
nodes.summary: Generated Rollup Visualizer HTML output (4950 lines). Contains inline CSS for treemap UI, a bundled Preact-based drawChart library, D3 scale modules (linear, sequential, etc.), and embedded JSON bundle data listing all source modules with sizes. Serves as a self-contained bundle size analysis report for the voxlblade-builder project.

edges.label: Contains embedded Preact, D3 scales, and drawChart visualization logic
